items.title: What happens as gut feel takes over from the rubric?
items.description: This is a simplified teaching model, not a real hiring formula. Candidate A scores 3 on the rubric but leaves a stronger first impression; Candidate B scores 5 on the rubric but leaves a weaker first impression. Drag the slider from rubric-driven to impression-driven and watch both candidate scores, not just the final gap.
items.compute: const rubricA = 3; const rubricB = 5; const impressionA = 5; const impressionB = 3; const w = params.gutWeight / 100; const candidateAScore = Math.round((rubricA * (1 - w) + impressionA * w) * 10) / 10; const candidateBScore = Math.round((rubricB * (1 - w) + impressionB * w) * 10) / 10; const scoreGap = Math.round((candidateBScore - candidateAScore) * 10) / 10; return { candidateAScore, candidateBScore, scoreGap };
